title: The R6B reference cases worked from the text captured in step P1: the corner-lot portion and coverage (K1), ZR 23-363 for interior and through lots (K2), the rear yard of ZR 23-342 (K4), special density areas (K11) - two independent readings from a sealed folder, a value only where both agree, every change with its reason (D-090 R226, R238, R241, R259, R291, R318)
objective: Work the reference-case rows that waited for step P1, from the law text captured by task M4-T025, and write them into the R6B reference cases (docs/plans/R6B_RESULTS_CONNECTION_WORK_ORDER_2026-10-06.md, section 8: 'new reference cases are worked from the new text, as in step R0', and section 5 gaps K1, K2, K4 and K11). INPUT MADE BY THE ORCHESTRATOR BEFORE THE BUILDER STARTS: two readings by two different AI helpers that took no part in writing the program's rules, each working alone from a sealed folder (every pinned law capture without its notes, the benchmark lot's recorded official facts and outline, no floor-area-ratio field, no program output) and with no access to the program or the repository; their returns are handed to the builder unchanged. The readings cover: (1) the ZR 12-10 definitions of corner, interior and through lot and of lot area: the lot type of the benchmark lot and of the made-up lots, and the portion of a corner lot that is subject to the corner-lot regulations; (2) maximum lot coverage for that portion and for any remaining portion (ZR 23-362 with ZR 23-363), and whether ZR 23-363 changes the interior-lot reading of the interior-lots case; (3) the rear yard: where one is required and how deep (ZR 23-342), and the area in which the corner provision applies; (4) what the ZR 12-10 definition of special density areas lists, and what the lot's recorded facts do and do not show about it. THE BUILDER then: saves the two returns unchanged under docs/reference-cases/R6B/provenance/; updates the case files so that each row that was 'not known' for want of captured text gets its facts, the quoted law with its capture id and digest, the arithmetic and the expected value where BOTH readings give the same value on the same basis, and stays 'not known' with the reason where they do not settle it or disagree (a disagreement is recorded with both readings and is not resolved by the builder); adds rows or a case where the readings cover something no row holds; writes a change-log entry with its reason for every changed value; updates the README section on law text that is not captured; re-renders the pages; extends the test support only as the new rows need. No coverage figure is stated for a whole lot unless the lot's geometry shows that the corner provision covers the whole lot (R238). Nothing in a case comes from a program run. No rule file, rule engine, capture, register entry, plan or screen changes.
business_reason: Step 3 of the owner's eight steps (R291) and the owner's rule that interpretation is checked with independently worked, source-backed examples kept apart from program output (R226, R241, R259, R318). The cases of step R0 (task M4-T024) record as 'not known' every value that needed text which was not captured then; that text is captured now (task M4-T025). The work order requires these cases before any rule or gate changes: their answers set the expected values for the later steps.
